marketing.title: Performance Marketing Agency
marketing.desc: We provide comprehensive digital marketing solutions that grow brands through the combination of data and creative.
marketing.about_desc1: LeadMeta's marketing agency service is committed to thorough data-driven performance marketing. We continuously iterate on media mix, targeting, and A/B testing to achieve concrete KPIs such as revenue growth, app installs, and visitor acquisition.
marketing.about_desc2: Our goal is not just ad impressions, but creating numbers that prove real business growth. We broadly utilize big media platforms like Google Ads, Meta, Naver, and Kakao, as well as native advertising infrastructure.
marketing.trend1_desc: Performance marketing, which precisely targets users with high purchase probability based on customer data, has become the core of the market, moving away from ads targeting unspecified masses.
marketing.trend2_desc: Active search behavior carries very clear 'purchase intent'. Search advertising (SA) and SEO optimization remain the highest-converting channels.
marketing.trend3_desc: With strengthening privacy trends, the importance of first-party data and strong content marketing integration is increasing.
marketing.rev1_desc: An official media agency commission model that is proportional to the advertising budget. This forms the most basic revenue structure.
marketing.rev2_desc: When target ROAS (Return on Ad Spend) is exceeded, additional incentives are distributed according to mutually agreed ratios, creating win-win synergy.
marketing.rev3_desc: Consulting fees for deriving brand positioning and core marketing strategies based on annual or monthly contracts.
marketing.str1_desc: We exclusively preempt search targets that competitors cannot find by utilizing back data from our proprietary keyword platform.
marketing.str2_desc: Native content publishing and backlink strengthening are possible through 10+ high-quality specialized blogs that we directly manage.
marketing.str3_desc: We provide detailed reports focused on 'conversion performance' rather than simple views, through hypothesis testing (A/B Testing), cohort analysis, and LTV measurement.

blognet.rev_f2: Organic traffic acquisition foundation through search engine optimization (SEO)
blognet.rev_f3: Maintaining high profitability relative to traffic by focusing on high-value keywords
blognet.data_desc: Beyond simple content production, we aim for systematic operation through thorough data-driven content planning and proprietary algorithms.
blognet.data_f1: Long-tail/low-competition high-value keyword discovery using 'AboutKeyword' solution
blognet.data_f2: Regular A/B testing for improving dwell time and bounce rate
blognet.data_f3: Minimized research-to-writing pipeline logic combining AI and automation tools
blognet.ben1_desc: Achieve high operating margins with only hosting and optimization resources, without physical inventory or large-scale infrastructure investment.
blognet.ben2_desc: Each specialized blog functions as digital real estate that generates monthly revenue and holds asset value.
blognet.ben3_desc: Our high-quality blog network can be utilized for initial backlink power-up and native advertising channels for future marketing services.
blognet.ben4_desc: A passive income pipeline where business runs 24/7/365 as long as there's an internet connection.
blognet.risk1_desc: To prepare for the biggest variable — Google search algorithm changes — we distribute risk across 10+ 'small-to-medium specialized blogs' instead of one 'large blog'.
blognet.risk2_desc: We thoroughly exclude abusive and pirated content, producing only clean information that users actually need, blocking account suspension risk.
